plan.goal: Add optional Unity-free Session observation, statistics, fingerprints, strict NDJSON, and privacy-sensitive trace/replay.
acceptance: Preserve every integrated Session and transport semantic with null, recording and throwing observers.
Expose only the frozen short diagnostics API with ordinary-log privacy and caller-owned observers/tapes.
Implement bounded allocation-free Observe, deterministic strict NDJSON and explicit loss records.
Implement exact bounded call-and-byte trace/replay without changing wrapped transport behavior.
Pass focused, full package, independent review and post-integration Unity validation.

execution.handoff: Implement the frozen diagnostics contract from exact code baseline 14459a615b46826269751f034c3eb53071614a33 in the isolated worktree; change only owned files and create one candidate commit.
validationEvidence: Read-only diagnostics and profiler discovery completed at exact baseline 14459a615b46826269751f034c3eb53071614a33.
The base diagnostics phase is intentionally Unity-free; the Unity Profiler adapter is a later dependent package.

Baseline review requested exact tape lifecycle and binary layout, terminal logger fault policy, role-specific resync cardinality and payload-only decoded byte accounting; the contract now freezes all five.
Cycle-2 review requested initial transport state and tag-specific transcript invariants; Trace now requires Connected/None and every tag has exact step, flags, channel and payload rules.
Independent gpt-5.6-sol:high baseline review accepted the complete frozen contract at planning head 74cb3b1beba08c0c4dde04b60261489e74ca4755.
Candidate edf4408982fdd2e9f6cbae10d784fbc17e52ba27 changes exactly 20 owned files; runtime and tests compile with zero warnings/errors in the standalone overlay.
Focused diagnostics/replay tests pass 18/18 and the full standalone package harness passes 161 tests; only the known baseline Mono allocation-counter anomaly was excluded.
Ownership, Unity meta, ordinary-log privacy, forbidden-name, whitespace and lemmings check --all scans are clean.
Strict repair 722d93ed325c028a914bf0f7a0bff26fde3bc5d4 fixes replay step/truncation validation, simultaneous-close State cardinality, and expands the focused acceptance matrix to 31 passing tests.
The repaired full standalone package reflection harness passes 174/174; the known baseline Mono allocation-counter defect remains the only excluded test.
